summary: Medical and Health Services Manager with over a decade of progressive leadership experience in industry-leading healthcare organizations, specializing in fiscal operations, staff supervision, and health information systems. Proven track record of optimizing resource utilization and implementing programs that improve operational efficiency and patient care delivery.

experience.title: Medical and Health Services Manager
bullets: Direct and supervise work activities of 85+ medical, nursing, technical, and clerical personnel across three departments, conducting performance evaluations and implementing training programs that increased staff competency scores by 22%.
Develop and maintain computerized record management systems to store and process personnel and patient data, producing monthly operational reports that reduced administrative processing time by 30%.

Plan, implement, and administer programs and services including personnel administration, training, and coordination of medical, nursing, and physical plant staff, launching a cross-departmental care coordination program that improved patient throughput by 18%.

Conduct and administer fiscal operations including accounting, budget planning, expenditure authorization, rate establishment, and financial reporting, managing an annual operating budget of $14M and reducing supply costs by 12% through vendor renegotiation.

Monitor use of diagnostic services, inpatient beds, facilities, and staff to ensure effective resource utilization, implementing a bed management system that increased occupancy efficiency by 15% and deferred $2M in capital expenditures.
Direct recruitment, hiring, and training of personnel, filling 40+ positions annually with a 95% retention rate at 12 months through structured onboarding and mentorship programs.

experience.title: Assistant Health Services Manager
bullets: Assisted in directing and evaluating work activities of nursing, technical, and support staff, coordinating schedules for 60+ employees based on workload, space, and equipment availability.

Maintained awareness of advances in medicine, computerized diagnostic equipment, data processing technology, government regulations, and health insurance changes, leading a regulatory compliance initiative that achieved 100% audit pass rate for three consecutive years.
Established work schedules and assignments for staff according to workload and facility needs, reducing overtime costs by 18% while maintaining adequate coverage.
Contributed to fiscal operations including budget planning, expenditure tracking, and financial reporting, identifying $500K in annual savings through process improvements.
Supported recruitment, hiring, and training efforts, developing a competency-based orientation program that decreased new-hire time-to-productivity by 25%.

experience.title: Health Information Management Coordinator
bullets: Developed and maintained computerized record management systems to store and process personnel activities and information, producing reports that supported executive decision-making.
Coordinated with medical, nursing, and administrative staff to ensure accurate and timely health information documentation, improving record completion rates from 82% to 97%.
Monitored use of diagnostic services and facilities to assess need for additional staff, equipment, and services, providing data-driven recommendations that informed a $3M facility expansion.
Conducted training sessions for clinical and administrative personnel on new data processing technology and regulatory requirements, training over 200 staff members.
Assisted with fiscal operations by tracking departmental expenditures and preparing variance reports for budget planning.

experience.title: Administrative Services Assistant
bullets: Supported daily administrative operations including scheduling, record-keeping, and correspondence for a 40-person department.
Assisted in maintaining computerized record systems and generating routine reports on personnel activities and service utilization.
Coordinated logistics for staff training sessions and meetings, ensuring effective use of space and equipment.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Health Services Management
